inc-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT PAGER — possible smart-routing + KV prefix mismatch detected. Symptoms: some requests routed to wrong model variant after region fallback. Triggered alerts: model-variant-mismatch-rate > 5% across prod regions. Paging oncall: @sara (oncall). Please ack and triage.

sara (oncall): Acked. I'm looking. Which customers are seeing this, any error rates or logs? Also linking runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/routing-fallback>

evan (support): FYI support side — 3 accounts have reported degraded outputs, one flagged as "incorrect style/formatting" after a region outage at ~02:10Z. Ticket ids: C-4312, C-4320, C-4329. Not widespread yet but escalated by account teams. Customers request ETA.

lee (sre): Quick triage: I can see a spike in KV cache hits that map to model variants that don't match the route metadata. Looks like redis keys for prefix cache are being written without region suffix in certain code paths. Example keys observed: `model-abc-quant:kv` vs expected `us-east-1:model-abc-quant:kv`. When region fallback happens we end up reusing cached KV from a different region/variant pair. That leads to requests getting embeddings/kv for wrong compiled kernels/quantization profile.

anita (ml): That would explain the format/decoder mismatches. The variant in the wrong cache is a 4-bit quantized variant; some of our decoding paths assume float16 and produce tokenization differences. Confirmed variant id mismatches in logs: expected `model-abc-v2-fp16` but runtime loaded `model-abc-v2-q4_0` on a subset of requests.

sara (oncall): Root cause hypothesis: KV/prefix cache keying omitted region under a feature flag rollout for smart routing. Recent change in routing policy code introduced a path that writes `kv_cache_key = model_id + ":kv"` instead of including route.region. This collides across regions during fallback. Next steps: (1) disable smart-routing fallback policy to stop cross-region reuse, (2) purge affected KV prefixes across redis clusters, (3) verify customers and mitigate.

lee (sre): I'll run the cache purge. Proposed safe command (will broadcast when running):

```bash
# purge kv prefixes for model-abc across clusters
for host in $(cat /srv/redis-clusters/prod-list.txt); do
  ssh $host "redis-cli -n 2 KEYS 'model-abc*' | xargs -r redis-cli -n 2 DEL"
done
```

Note: doing cold mass DELs could cause latency for warmups. I'll target only keys matching the variant prefixes and coordinate with canary.

ops-bot: Deploy request accepted: temporarily applying override `routing.fallback.enabled = false` in prod via feature-flag manager. Change id: FF-2026-1802. Rolling update across control plane.

mike (product): Thumbs up to pause fallback. We should also throttle any automatic variant promotion. Need immediate customer communication; Evan please send an interim note to affected accounts: "We've identified a routing cache keying issue; mitigation underway; possible degraded responses earlier; ETA 45 min."

evan (support): Sending note now. Will include recommended remediation steps (clear client cache) and that we are not changing model behavior intentionally.

lee (sre): Executing targeted purge now on canary cluster (ap-southeast-1) to validate safety. Running command:

```bash
redis-cli -h ap-southeast-1-redis01 -n 2 --scan --pattern 'model-abc*' | xargs -r redis-cli -h ap-southeast-1-redis01 -n 2 DEL
```

Will monitor error budget and latency graphs. Posting logs shortly.

anita (ml): After purge, we should pin a canary route to `model-abc-v2-fp16` for 10m to validate output shape/format across 1000 requests. I'll prepare prompt set.

sara (oncall): Handoff note: I'm going offline in 20m to sleep shift. Leaving active lead to @lee (sre). Summary: disable fallback (ops-bot applied), targeted KV purge started in canary, support notified, postmortem ticket created. If anything regresses escalate to @anita and @mike. Pager status: acknowledged -> investigating -> mitigation in progress.

lee (sre): Took over. Canary purge completed: keys removed in ap-southeast-1. Observed decrease in variant-mismatch-rate from 7.2% -> 0.8% in that region. Proceeding to batch purge in us-east-1 next, with a 2-minute stagger between hosts to avoid thundering herd. Will run purge only for keys matching `model-abc-v2-*` variants.

ops-bot: Feature flag override `routing.fallback.enabled = false` applied globally at 1802505401. Rolling back any autoscaling/fallback triggers.

evan (support): Customers updated. One requested status page entry — publishing incident summary now.

mike (product): After we stabilize, we need to ship a quick fix: ensure KV key includes route metadata (region + variant + model_id) and add unit tests for key construction. Also a postmortem runbook item to detect when cache-key cardinality collapses.

lee (sre): Mitigation complete. us-east-1 purge finished at 1802507120. Metrics: variant-mismatch-rate back to baseline (~0.1%). No new customer complaints in last 30m. Re-enabling fallback must wait until we deploy code fix.

anita (ml): Confirming canary outputs match expected for pinned route. Good to proceed with code fix and test.

sara (oncall): Thanks team, I'm back for a quick debrief. Creating postmortem ticket: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/PM-2026-58>. Owner @mike (product). Action items: code fix for keying, add e2e for routing+cache, deploy canary, and permanent telemetry for cross-region cache collisions.

mike (product): Assigning follow-ups and timeline. ETA for fix and rollout 2 business days unless critical hotfix needed. I'll coordinate with release engineering.

inc-bot: Incident transitioned to "Mitigated" at 1802507342. Please ensure followup items are tracked and a postmortem is published within 3 business days.
